title: Bliss/Loewe Synergy Analysis for Combining Safety Steering Vectors

original_idea.body: Apply Bliss/Loewe drug-synergy analysis to pairs of safety steering vectors via a 2D dose grid; compute synergy/antagonism. Inference-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: synergy/antagonism of stacked safety steers informs defense-in-depth, but the link is one step broader (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: 2D dose grid + Bliss-surface fitting; clear methodology, statistics-friendly, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (synergy map for vector pairs), 2D grid sweeps add modest effort (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly fuzzy-interaction evaluation labs deprioritize, open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Applying Bliss/Loewe synergy analysis to steering vectors appears mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Pharmacological synergy framework for steering combination appears underexplored.
